prevention_notes: validate-round and validate-canonical-repair should use consistent checkout depth (fetch-depth: 0) for merge-commit-aware validation
no-ff merge commit messages must still include required token and safety disclaimers in all future merges
future merge instructions must not use --no-edit when required token is mandatory
CI infrastructure (workflow checkout depth) and governance (merge message compliance) are independent concerns — fixing one does not resolve the other
validate-round should match validate-canonical-repair checkout behavior since both run merge-commit-aware validators
